title: Structurally valid invalid-session SendRRData
purpose: Exercise invalid-session handling using a fully valid SendRRData outer and inner structure so rejection occurs on session semantics rather than malformed framing.
expected_behavior: A compliant target should report or internally handle the invalid session condition while the packet remains useful for valid CPF and CIP parsing coverage on permissive implementations.
constraints_preserved: Session handle is nonzero but no malformed fields are present.
Null Address and Unconnected Data item headers are complete and valid.
Unconnected Data Item length 6 matches the CIP payload.
issue_safety_notes: Only the session-handle value is adversarial; CPF and CIP structure remain valid to avoid exact malformed-parser crash triggers.
